input_sentence: Eurovision 2026 is being held in Vienna from May 12 to May 16.
headline: Bulgaria Wins Eurovision 2026 in Vienna with Record-Breaking Margin
dek: DARA's "Bangaranga" triumphed at the 70th Eurovision Song Contest, held at the Wiener Stadthalle, giving Bulgaria its first-ever victory by the largest winning margin in the contest's history.
summary: The 70th Eurovision Song Contest took place in Vienna, Austria, from May 12–16, 2026, at the Wiener Stadthalle — the city's third time hosting the event. Bulgaria's DARA won the Grand Final on May 16 with "Bangaranga," topping both the jury vote and televote by a record 173-point margin over the second-place entry. The contest featured 35 participating countries, with five nations (Iceland, Ireland, the Netherlands, Slovenia, and Spain) boycotting over Israel's inclusion. Romania finished third, equaling its best-ever placement, while Australia and Italy rounded out the top five.

why_it_matters: The 70th anniversary edition was a landmark moment for the contest, producing Bulgaria's first-ever winner and the highest winning margin in Eurovision history. Five countries staged the largest boycott since 1970 over Israel's participation, reflecting how the geopolitical tensions around the Gaza conflict have increasingly spilled into the contest. The record sell-out speed and Vienna's city-wide programming underline Eurovision's growing status as one of the world's biggest live entertainment events.
whats_next: Bulgaria, as the 2026 winner, earns the right to host — or delegate hosting of — Eurovision 2027.
ORF and BNT (Bulgarian National Television) will begin discussions on the 2027 host city and venue selection.
The five boycotting countries (Iceland, Ireland, Netherlands, Slovenia, Spain) will decide whether to return for Eurovision 2027.
EBU may revisit participation rules regarding Israel following the historic five-country boycott.

extras.results: Bulgaria won with "Bangaranga" by DARA, topping both the jury vote and televote by a record 173-point margin. Top 5: Bulgaria, Israel, Romania, Australia, Italy.
extras.how_to_watch: Broadcast live by participating national broadcasters. Public screenings were held at Eurovision Village (Rathausplatz, May 10–17) and EuroClub (Prater Dome, May 11–16).
